text: The framing here is genius — using an "AI doom spreader" villain to showcase student work hits harder than any straightforward showcase reel would. What struck me most was the line about fluency without judgment being "just a faster way to make the same mistakes." That's the real thesis. Tools like Claude or GPT are easy to use, but knowing when something is wrong before you can prove it — that's the skill that actually compounds. The projects speak for themselves, but the underlying message is what I'm taking with me.
